# P3BR2 final review (read-only)

**Verdict: APPROVE** — Both P3BR1 Composer **P2** items are addressed on disk; empty-hub honesty and publication boundaries hold; no **P0–P1** or blocking **P2** regressions found. Command exits in the worker report were **not** re-run (per your constraint).

---

## Packet scope vs disk

| P3BR2 requirement | Evidence |
|-------------------|----------|
| Shared search + lesson filters on **all** hubs, including empty grammar/listening/concepts | `HubListView` always renders `HubFilters` before the results branch (`HubViews.tsx` 248–265). Category only when `hub.categories.length > 0` (144–196). |
| Keep **“No published items yet”**; no fabricated **“No matches”** on zero-item hubs | Branch order: `itemCount === 0` → `HubEmptyPublished` regardless of query (250–251). UI test with `q` + `lesson` still expects empty copy, not no-match (174–181). |
| Accessible labels, GET form, honest summary, no fake mastery/due | `htmlFor` / `aria-label` on search and lesson; `method="get"`; active vs “No active filters”; placeholder banner only (133–217). UI asserts no learned/due/mastery/streak controls (167–172). |
| **“Showing N after filters”** only when there is published content | `showAfterFilters = hub.itemCount > 0 && filtered.hasActiveFilters` (231, 241–243); empty-hub tests forbid `after filters` (164–165, 185). |
| Independent recursive scan of **actual** `learner-hubs.json` bytes | `readFileSync(generatedHubsPath)` + parse + `collectStrings`/`collectKeys` + raw `diskText` checks (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 229–326). |
| Same boundary as serializer scan; keep prior checks | Serializer walk retained (186–227); ID-set test (168–184); determinism (364–374). |

This closes the two optional **P2** items called out in [P3BR1 Composer result](research/cursor-execution/P3BR1-composer-review-result.json): empty hubs omitting filters, and leak scan only on in-memory serialization.

---

## Empty-hub behavior (grammar / listening / concepts)

- **Implementation:** Filters sit above `HubEmptyPublished`; meta still shows `0 published` and `Showing 0` without “after filters” when `itemCount === 0`.
- **Behavioral tests:** `p3b-hubs-ui.test.ts` 139–189 loops `grammar`, `listening`, `concepts`: filter chrome, no `name="category"`, retained empty state with and without active filters, vocabulary still has category.
- **Logic:** `itemCount === 0` wins over `filtered.items.length === 0`, so active filters on an empty hub cannot flip the UI to **No matches** (correct vs P3B distinction).

On-disk artifact matches expectations for empty hubs (e.g. grammar `itemCount: 0`, `items: []`, `kinds: ["GrammarConcept"]` in `learner-hubs.json`).

---

## On-disk artifact scan (independent of serializer)

The new test:

1. Parses bytes from `platform/apps/web/generated/learner-hubs.json`.
2. Asserts `schemaVersion` `1.0.0`, `projectionKind` `learner-hubs`, `hubCount` 6, hub ID order vs `LEARNER_HUB_IDS`.
3. Per hub in `hubsById`: `id`, `itemCount === items.length`, item ID set vs `independentHubIdSets(indexes)`, `kinds` vs `HUB_KIND_MEMBERSHIP`, each item `publicationStatus === "published"` and kind in membership.
4. Recursive string/key walk plus **raw file text** for: `KNOWN_REVIEW_ONLY_IDS`, `LEARNER_REVIEW_ONLY_ACTIVITY_IDS`, non-published statuses, `assert:`, `.mp3`, paths, `FORBIDDEN_KEY_FRAGMENTS`, forbidden top-level key names, and all review/draft/blocked IDs from `author.publicationStatusById`.

This is strictly stronger than the pre-P3BR2 serializer-only walk and does not replace the existing ID-set or determinism tests.

---

## Regression check (P3BR1 baseline)

| Area | Status |
|------|--------|
| Six hubs + `/hubs`, membership from learner index | Unchanged tests (`p3b-hubs.test.ts` 127–166). |
| Serializer recursive leak scan | Retained (186–227). |
| Query sanitization / German matching / adversarial | Unchanged (`411–561`). |
| Empty vs no-match honesty | Extended, not weakened (119–137 + 139–189). |
| Nav / aria-current / 404 / disabled Review·Profile | Unchanged UI tests (56–117, 213–242). |
| P3A routes + review-only activity 404 | Unchanged (391–408). |
| SSR markup reflection | Unchanged (244–264). |
| Hub cards not linking detail routes | Unchanged (201–211). |

`hub-query.ts` and route/access layers were not part of P3BR2 writes; `HubListView` change is localized and does not alter publication or query semantics.

---

## P0–P1

None identified in reviewed artifacts.

---

## Non-blocking P2 (traceability only)

- **A11y on empty hubs:** Labels/`htmlFor`/`aria-labelledby` are present in `HubFilters`; the new UI test checks filter presence and honesty, not every a11y attribute on empty hubs.
- **“Showing 0” on empty hubs with active filters:** Honest (no invented results); copy is not separately specified beyond tests forbidding “after filters”.

---

## APPROVE (concise)

1. **P3BR2 fix 1:** P3B filter surface on empty hubs without substituting review data or **No matches**.
2. **P3BR2 fix 2:** CI-hardening via independent parse + recursive scan of committed `learner-hubs.json`, aligned with serializer boundaries.
3. **No approval transfer** from the worker report or P3BR1 Composer JSON — this is an independent read-only review only.
